name: Brimaz, Blight of Oreskos
oracle_text:
Whenever you cast a Phyrexian creature or artifact creature spell, incubate X, where X is that spell's mana value. (Create an Incubator token with X +1/+1 counters on it and "{2}: Transform this token." It transforms into a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature.)
At the beginning of each end step, if a Phyrexian died under your control this turn, proliferate.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of each end step, if a Phyrexian died under your control this turn, proliferate.

needs.what: a turn-ledger value counting creatures that died this turn under a given player's control, filtered by the dead creature's last-known characteristics (here subtypes: ["Phyrexian"]), usable as an end_step trigger's intervening-if condition
needs.why_existing_wont_do: creatures_died_this_turn, nontoken_creatures_died_this_turn and modified_creatures_died_this_turn are keyed only by player and take no creature filter, so they cannot ask whether the dead creature was a Phyrexian; a creature_dies trigger setting a turn flag would be an unprinted ability that misses Phyrexians that died before Brimaz entered or while it was off the battlefield
